name: Yamatsuri (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yamatsuri town emblem in white: a stylised bird-like device enclosing a leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Yamatsuri, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 April 1973.

features.role: Yamatsuri town emblem — a stylised bird-like device enclosing a leaf
